provenance: AI-edited online photographs supplied by user. Fictional labels; real source scenes approximated. Not 24 independent source photographs and not real deployment evidence.
split_policy: Do not random-split related images. source_id and packaging_family_id group derived/correlated examples. No untouched holdout claimed for these user-reviewed development cases.
ground_truth_policy: Quantities are separate from product names. null means visually unknowable, false means a clearly visible label with no halal mark. Verify every finished image against these prewritten targets before inference. Regenerate mismatches; do not tune targets to model predictions.
evaluation_status: No RunPod calls, predictions, timing measurements or accuracy scores collected.
